annotations.title: Find a product and its prices per chain

description: Searches watch.diy's index of DIY and garden products at German retailers (OBI, Bauhaus, toom, Hornbach, hagebau, Globus and more) by product name, EAN or manufacturer part number (MPN), and returns up to `limit` (1-5, default 3) products, best match first. Per product: name, brand, its EANs and per retailer the retailer's product name, its product page url and price with priceAsOf (when the price was read; a price older than 35 days is returned as null with priceNote). Only products the retailers sell themselves and still list online; store availability is not part of this answer: use where_to_buy_nearby with an EAN from here and a German postcode. Also returns match (ean, identifier, hybrid or text: how the query was answered) and a notice. When nothing matches, products is empty and message says what the index covers. Limits: public lookups are limited per client. Errors: invalid_request (names the field and the reason), quota_exceeded (with the minutes until it can be tried again), public_unavailable.

query.description: Product name or description (any language, typos tolerated), an EAN (8 or 12-14 digits) or a manufacturer part number (MPN)

name: find_product

match.description: How the query was answered: ean / identifier (exact), hybrid (full text + semantic), text (full text)

eans.description: The product's EANs; pass one to where_to_buy_nearby for store availability

price.description: EUR; null when unknown or older than 35 days

priceAsOf.description: When the price was read (ISO 8601, UTC)

priceNote.description: Present when a known price is hidden for its age

title: Find a product and its prices per chain
